nom: belif Aqua Bomb Depuffing Eye Gel with Caffeine + Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: I have puffy under-eyes, and have had them forever. I think I have tried every product on the market, and yet have to find something that actually reduces under-eye bags. This doesn't, but it does hydrate very well. If you want hydration, check it out, but for me at least it didn't help depuff at all.

This little bottle packs a big hydrating and cooling sensation that hydrates under eyes very well. Unfortunately the applicatior dispenses double the product I need so it's too wasteful for me but my husband also really loves it.

avis.titre: Worked Great for my Under Eyes
avis.texte: This product is so amazing. I would say after a month with concsistent use, I really saw a difference of the fine lines and dark circles that I had underneath my eye. When I used to put concealer, it would not cover up my dark circles, even with a color corrector. Now, when I do my usual makeup routine, my eyes look so clean and not dark anymore!

avis.titre: Incredible for the delicate skin around the eyes.
avis.texte: I had been struggling to find an effective eye cream that provided enough moisture for the delicate slin around my eyes, without causing irritation. This came as a sample after another Ulta purchase - and how grateful I am to have tried it. Noticeable results almost immediately. I will definitely begin purchasing this on a regular basis.
it's honestly such a great product, supper moisturizing. I have oily skin and most moistures cause breakouts because my skin doesn't absorb them! this eyes hydrates me and melts into my face

avis.titre: Best eye cream ever, worst applicator
avis.texte: Best eye cream ive ever used. Received a sample in a previous order, tried it for a few days and eye bags were GONE! Ordered full size and still love the cream, but worst applicator ive ever used. Takes SO much pressure to dispense, it hurts! Ended up pressing onto my finger and dabbing it on- dont teally want a bruise under my eye!
I have such puffy eyelids and this helps so much! Especially first thing in the morning.

Unfortunately I noticed I would get a small rash/redness after using this procuct for a couple of days-a week and also didn't see a difference. The only thing I liked was how it felt cool when applied & refreshed after. Tbh this is worth like $10 or less
I have a sample size that lasted me a month and it didn't improve my undereyes what so ever

avis.titre: Great item bye for puffy dark under eyes
avis.texte: Only item eye cream that has given me results in fixing my dark under eyes its refreshing and works perfectly pls invest!

Just meh. You have to press down hard on the applicator for anything to come out and it honestly hurts so I end up pressing it with my finger and just applying it that way—not even using the applicator. Doesn't hydrate well, def won't get again
The applicator is very cooling and refreshing. The formula definitely brightens the under eye which is exactly what I was hoping for. Looking forward to trying more from this brand!

It really helps me feel more awake, especially when I have to be up by 4am for work. Really convenient/ on the go, and I try to use this product twice per day, if not at least once everyday. My dark circles looks less visible
Caused me to have redness under eyes and dry payches i gave it several chanves seeing if it wss another product i use and no everytime i used this so much irritation under my eyes
Maybe my bags are too puffy because it didnt help at all. The cooling is nice.

I have fine lines amd a few deep ones around the lower eye and upper eye lid is droopy. It really worked making them disappear. Then I had some leftover on my finger and put it on my only wrinkle on my forehead (really a good forehead) and it disappeared! I got it in a sample and im ording it!

I'm 31 (fine lines and dark circles), and currently struggling with super dry skin around my eyes from rets. I had a tester of this and decided to try it out. I walked out of my bathroom after application, and when I walked back in a few mins later I was SHOCKED at how bright and plump my undereyes looked! I've never used an eye cream that gave an instant result like this one- I immediately ordered the full size.

I've been using this consistently for about 2 weeks. I have dark circles under my eyes. The product says visible difference noticed. Although I really like the applicatuor because it feels cold and calming I feel like the product doesn't really soak in to your skin, it just sits on the surface. It has made no impact on my dark circles.
The way you have to get the product out is annoying U have to press it into ur hand because pressing on face would be too much pressure and its hard to come out
I'm prone to milia so i love that this is a light gel formula. this isnt the same as a blepharoplasty but it helps soften the fine lines around my eyes by adding hydration

I got this for my 16-year-old daughter, who has a hereditary puffy under-eye. It works wonders! Every time she uses it, someone asks her what she did differently with her eyes. I used it under my forty-some-year-old under eye. It's really wonderful, not greasy or shiny looking, but hydrating and very smoothing yet very lightweight. I certainly see brighter undereye when I use it, and if I'm using concealer, it sits smoothly over it. No irritation or itchy eyes, and I even use it for my upper eyelid too. I will definitely buy many more to stack up during the 50% sale on September 18th.

I got a free sample of this in an Ulta gift with purchase and used the entire thing over the course if two months. I saw absolutely no difference in puffiness, dark circles, or texture. The only reason I didn't give it 1 star is that it is pleasant to apply and feels cooling. I guess it could work as an overpriced gel moisturizer for the eye area, but only if you need a light moisture. This does not deliver a lot of moisture. I liked it for day time but use something much thicker for night time. I have combo skin and am 42 with some fine lines, for what it's worth. I would never pay more than say $5-10 for this product.
swear by this product! you don't need much product so it actually lasts. i've seen a huge difference in my under eyes since i started using this last year. a new staple!
This id really good but i need like a jumbo soze this only lasts me like 3 months. My neutrogena one lasts me almost a year

I'm in my 30's and have been struggljng with fine lines under my eyes, even with eye cream used twice daily. This formula is very lightweight, super hydrating, and has really softened the lines under my eyes. My under-eye skin looks smoother and more refreshed. I will absolutley be buying this again and again and again. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

First received this as a trial size in one of those "spend x$ and get this free bag of goodies" and immediately fell in love. I already use Belif products (the moisturzing eye cream & moisturizing bomb face cream) so I'm already familiar with the brand, and this is now another item I'm keeping in my daily routine. It's a thin, clear gel and feels so refreshing in the morning. I love how quickly it absorbs into the skin so I can put it on whenever I want a little boost of moisture under my eyes. And it literally helps me look so much more awake in the morning! Idk how it does it but it does haha Again, love this product!! I've already bought it twice when on sale to stock up.

Stopped in the Lisbon store. Was offered the credit card. Received a sample of Belif Aqua Bomb (first gift I've received from Ulta) Tried it out and saw emendate results. After a few days, dramatic, lasting improvement. Had to get more! Love it!

I saw great reviews on this product. I purchased and used it. I'm not impressed. It didn't work for me the way people claimed it would. I see absolutely no difference before and after use or improvement over time.
I recently began using this eye gel and I really love the ceramic applicator and the hydration that it provides me. Belief has quality products and this one is no exception.
This burns really badly if you get it too close to your eye. This is also so thin it doesnt feel like its doing anything. Their other eye cream is much better.

I've never thought that eye creams I've tried varied much/had a ton of noticeable benefits from formula to formula until I found this one! Not sure if it's the ceramic applicator, the formula, or the perfect duo of both working together, but I notice a VISIBLE difference in the puffiness of my eyes when using this in the morning. Perfect for doing a gentle massage around the eye/brow bone area when I have a tension headache from staring at a screen as well. Absolutely love this and have recommended to everyone I know!

I've been using this once a day everyday for 4 months now. I can say it's an okay product. It moisturizes well enough but that's about it. Doesn't help with puff, color, or lines. I never felt a "cooling" effect. Just feels like a regular room temperature product.

I actually loved this eye cream while it was usable. I've been dealing with really puffy eyes due to allergies and this really helped reduce the swelling in the mornings. I kept it in the box in the refrigerator and would follow up with some ice rollers after. However, after about a week and a half of use, I accidentally dropped the box on the floor. When I opened it up, the applicator tip had snapped off. It's completely useless now. Very disappointing for a product that is not cheap.
Bought this product to help de-puff my under-eyes and it did nothing. Don't waste your money on this.

I (23f very fair skin) have tried a lot of products for my dark circles and nothing worked until this eye gel. In just a few days I noticed the brightening effects, with the darkness and fine veins in my undereyes almost invisible. It depuffs within about 10min and with consistent morning and evening use my undereyes stay in good shape. Not much concealer is necessary anymore and I hope to improve enough to not have to wear that makeup. The only caution would be what's expected, don't get it directly in the eyes because it'll burn pretty badly. It's doing a great job healing my skin after I wasn't in the best health. This stuff is worth every penny.

avis.titre: Good serum good for depuffing and tightening
avis.texte: Ive been using this for a month now with the eye cream. Ive use the eye cream for a while love it and now using the serum ive seen a good difference in my under eye area. My under eye is less dark and the lines under my eyes have soften. I also find this is a good depuffer for the morning

avis.titre: Good serum good for depuffing and tightening
avis.texte: Ive been using this for a month now with the eye cream. Ive use the eye cream for a while love it and now using the serum ive seen a good difference in my under eye area. My under eye is less dark and the lines under my eyes have soften. I also find this is a good depuffer for the morning
This keeps my under eyes smooth and hydrated. An everyday must for me.

I use this twice a day and have for a week. I can see a huge difference already! I have a line under both eyes that is now almost all gone. I use this 2x per day as directed, and feels so nice!! The smell is nice and not overwhelming which is a plus as well.

I started using this almost a month ago. I have terrible dark circles and saw that i have fine lines as well. I didn't see a difference in dark circles, though saw that my under eyes are more plump and healthy looking. Results were not instant. Took come time. But it has a cooling sensation I like. It's thick and won't absorb quickly though. Not well under the make up. But would use it some more and see if it helps with dark circles.

this is a great product. i love the cooling ceramic tip and the component that the product is in. it's a lightweight gel formula that absorbs quickly into the eye area. being someone who's used countless eye creams and gels ovee the years, this is the first product where i was able to see and immediate difference! my undereyes were drastically less puffy after the first usage. i look forward to see what the results will look like with continued use!

avis.titre: FINALLY FOUND MY HOLY GRAIL EYE SERUM
avis.texte: I have tried just about every eye serum and eye mask, and eye cream on the market. if it is sold here or the other store that I no longer support, I have tried it. this is the -first- that showed results. not subtle results. my undereyes are so dramatically more youthful and less crepey. the skin feel bouncy and smooth again. it helps with puffiness. I don't know that it helps with dark circles, but honestly, if they're genetic, no eye magic will work. I use this morning and night. goes well under makeup. helps concealer not settle. I'm in LOVEEEEE! NEVER stop making it? please???
My eyes burned for 40 minutes after using this oh my god do not get it.
I did not realize how parched my skin was until I tried this! Omg my skin feels so soft and supple and helps to relieve tired eyes!

Ive been using belif for a while and its one of my favorite and go-to prestige brands! I love their toner and aquabomb moisturizer. I'm not surpsied that I love this eye gel as well! It took me a while to see results maybe almost a month and I saw a huge difference with my dark circles. My dark circles are basically GONE! The cooling sensation also helps with depuffing in the morning which I really like. Overall if you are interested to buy this for your dark circles give it some time to to fully see those results!

The applicator does not glide well at all which defeats part of the product's gimmick. The serum feels nice but haven't had it long enough to tell any difference. Probably wouldn't buy again as I'm sure the metal applicator raises the price of the item

avis.titre: No results- caffeine led to eye twitching
avis.texte: I've used this product consistently for 3 weeks, and I saw no results. I have under-eye patches that after 1 application reduce puffiness and dark circles, so I know it's possible- but this product is not it. Also, I developed significant eye-twitching in both eyes from the caffeine in the product. This had been reducing since I stopped using it 2 weeks ago, but they're not totally gone yet.

As usual with Belif, all their products are amazing and I am once again sad I can't live without a pricey product lol. I've always suffered from bad dark circles from being pale, having deep set eyes, and thin skin in that area. I have tried countless vitamin c, retinol, other brightening products that made zero difference because I realized the issue is not discolored skin for me, the area is sunken and needs to be plumped. Caffeine and hyaluronic acid products seem to be the only thing that helps fill the area. I have tried the Yerba eye gel as well, but did not notice much difference. I can see a significant visible difference using this within an hour. The photos are before/after of only one use with an hour time difference, I imagine the results will be even better after a few weeks.

I bought this on recommendation of an influencer. I have puffy eye bags that I'm hoping this will eventually help but so far it's very moisturizing and helps concealer stay and not settle into under eye. Hoping for a miracle on puffiness!

avis.titre: I will but this product again an again definitely.
avis.texte: I use this product under my eyes before moisturizer and I just love everything about it. I don't think there's anything I just like.. I use this product under my eyes before moisturizer and I just love everything about it. I don't think there's anything I just like.
The manufacturing of the product is very poor. Right out of the box the pump doesn't work. I've tried everything and nothing comes out.
I opened the package and the pump doesn't work. No gel comes out. I have tried everything and nothing…. Poor production

I love the applicator! It gives a spa experience feel to it by being able to put the cream on your under eyes and use the applicator to massage the cream into your skin. The cream has a cooling sensation that is very refreshing to tired eyes! It also plumps my fine lines to make my skin look & feel smoother.

I'm obsessed with this pen, my eyes are always super puffy in the morning and the applicator makes it easy to apply the lightweight gel & press into my under eyes. There's a visible difference after using it and the feel is super refreshing.

avis.titre: I would buy this again & again ! You hear me !!
avis.texte: Great product , light and so soothing I've been looking for something to help the bags under my eyes without hurting my sensitive skin ! Will be purchasing after my sample runs out :)

I enjoyed this Aqua bomb eye gel from Belif. It helped make me looked a little more awake and my dark circles weren't quite as bad. I don't like the applicator however. I need to use my fingers otherwise it won't soak in and just leaves in thick

I really liked this product for how well it reduced my eye bags and my dark circles that I had!! It definitely helped to depuffed my eyes in the mornings. It's very fresh and light weight on my eyes I definitely recommend this product for people who are struggling with dark circles and eye bags!

Love this product! I have noticed a difference since using it. It took a minute to figure out the right amount of product to dispense so the applicator doesn't pull on the skin around my eyes. Now that I know I feel naked without it. It also don't add to my already oily skin which is a huge plus in my book.

avis.titre: Great lightweight and soothing eye gel
avis.texte: This gel is so nice and hydrating! I love the ceramic tip which is really nice and soothes any inflammation. It took down my dark circles and puffiness that I have come to know in my early 40s. The size is really generous and this is my daytime eye product for the time being. The pen is really easy and comfortable to hold and no product is wasted.

I love Aqua Bomb Eye Gel! The cooling effect feels so nice and the product is gentle yet moisturizing around the delicate eye area. I have definitely seen improvement regarding puffines and my eye area while also adding the perfect amount of refreshing moisture. A bonus is the wand you apply the gel with is so convenient and aids in application.

avis.titre: I would absolutely buy this product and recommend it to ever
avis.texte: I love the applicator and it makes my eyes look amazing. I would recommend this product to anyone. My bags under my eyes have decreased

I really liked how light/thin this product was and that it was always cool-feeling. I'm not sure how I feel about the unique applicator design as it was hard to tell when I needed more product/where I was placing the product and got messy at times. Both my husband and I used this, but didn't notice a huge difference/big results. I'll likely keep using it, but not sure if I'd purchase it.

avis.titre: Nice product but saw no real results
avis.texte: I liked a lot of things about the product- the applicator tip, the amount of product that came out when used, and the feeling of the product on my eyes (nice and cooling)- but I saw minimal if any improvements from the product. I do not have super dark circles or bags, but I found the product did not do much to immediately lighten or tighten them compared to other products I have tried. I also haven't seen much of a long term improvement either, although I am sure the hydration doesn't hurt. I really wanted to like it so I did give it some time before reviewing, but unfortunately this product is not a "must buy" for me.
It reduced my eye bags from underneath my eyes from staying up late. And I using this eye gel to prevent me from getting lines and wrinkles.

First time I use Aqua Bomb eye gel. It works pretty good for my eye area. I would recommend this product and I would use it again. "Avon, PJ Beauty 7 sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program."

I don't have dark circles under my eyes, but I do wake up with puffiness and starting to get some fine lines. This gel is cooling and great for usage in the mornings. Would highly recommend and will continue to use it!

Thanks Belif for the free product to sample! I really like the ceramic tip applicator, it's a gentle way to apply the gel. This product did a really good job of reducing puffiness under my eyes while soothing and moisturizing the skin. My skin can be sensitive at times and this felt really nice and didn't cause any irritation or breakout.
This product took me by surprise on how quickly and effectively it worked.

I'm always skeptical of these kinds of products because I usually don't see much difference, but after using this every day for a few weeks, I can say I actually do see that my dark circles are less visible and the cooling does help depuff. I also appreciate the design of the applicator; it spreads the eye gel nicely.
I really enjoyed the aqua bomb eye gel. I am always looking for good moisturizing products as I get older. This was very hydrating. I have sensitive skin and this did not irritate my skin at all.

This eye gel definitely perks up my under eye bags after a sleepless night. It's also very hydrating and the gel absorbs quickly. My only issue is that you have to be careful with the applicator because one full pump dispenses way too much product.
This product didn't help me with my under eyes. the formula didn't want to absorb into my skin (could be a me problem). it took me about 50 times to pump in order to get product. i wouldn't get this

avis.titre: The only eye cream that hasn't clogged my pores
avis.texte: I've been using eye creams for a while, but they've always clogged the pores beneath my eyes, and had minimal effect on my dark circles. The Belif Aqua Bomb Eye Gel is the only product I've tried that has been worth using. Since it is a gel formula, the product is lightweight, and lets my skin breath. The hyaluronic acid plumps my eye bags, while the caffeine brightens the appearance of the dark circles. All this in conjunction with the self cooling, ceramic applicator makes for a great product that depuffs, glides on easily, and leaves my eyes feeling refreshed.

This is a fantastic product with hydration that is unmatched by even my high end products! Its lightweight-yet powerful. The packaging is so unique and functional, that It makes it fun to use! I have recommended this to all of my sisters and girlfriends and have had such positive feedback!

I received this product for free in exchange of my honest review. I love the scent of every Belif product. They all have a very natural calming herbal scent. This eye gel as well. The applier is made of some kind of ceramic or metal that it feels cool to the touch, even without the eye gel on it. You can pump the gel out even it faces up. I really like about that. The gel feels light and absorbs fast. However I didn't see much improvement in the puffiness of my eyes. I still have dark circles under my eyes.
Use under and around the eye. The large applicator makes it a little difficult to control and I ended up getting a little in my eye. The product is light weight and didn't mess up my makeup.

I received the Aqua Bomb Eye Gel from BzzAgent, in exchange for my honest review. This product is amazing! I absolutely love the applicator and how easy it is to apply without using my finger tips, unlike others I've used. It hydrates and moisturizes my under eye without leaving any sticky residue and I immediately feel more awake when I use it in the mornings. One of my favorite products!

Belif sent me this free sample of Aqua Bomb Eye Gel through the BzzAgent sampling program. I used the product for about a week as directed twice a day (morning and evening). It took about 3 days for me to see a difference in my undereyes - but i did see a difference. The dark circles faded, the plumpness returned to the area and the skin looked brighter overall. The formula is great for sensitive skin, no fragrance and water based so absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a sticky residue. My only complaint is that it took longer than i expected to see results but once i saw them the wait was worth it. I will for sure be buying this product again!

avis.titre: Reduces puffiness feels cool on the skin
avis.texte: I really liked the dispenser for this gel. For me, half a pump is enough to cover both my under eyes and you rub it in with the applicator. I felt a slight cooling sensation which I really enjoyed. I didn't immediately notice a difference in the darkness under my eyes but I noticed the puffiness went down significantly. After two weeks, the creases under my eyes are not as visible. It does feel sticky when it dries but it works well when applying makeup. I even got my mom hooked on it.
I would use this product in the morning after I washed my face and before I put on my moisturizer, and it was perfect for de puffing the shopping bags under my eyes :-)

I like the applicator for this product! It is cooling and so very easy to use. I saw great results after using this product for a few weeks.less wrinkles and puffiness. This is my new go to eye treatment!

The product was easy to use and even easier to apply. With a quick pump, I could simply apply the applicator to my skin and rub in the product. It dried very quickly and didn't leave any sticky residue on my skin. It improved the puffiness under my eyes, which is a major issue for me.

avis.titre: I love this stuff and you will too!
avis.texte: I've been using this for a few weeks now and I absolutely love it. The applicator has a little hole that the gel comes from when you squeeze down on it. Once there is gel on the applicator, you just gently rub under your eye. It has a cooling effect which feels great on stressed out eyes. The gel helps with puffiness and those under the eye problems that are so common. I will continue to buy this product because it works so well.

I recently tried the Belief Aqua Bomb Eye Gel, and I'm genuinely impressed ❤️ From the moment I applied it, I felt a refreshing coolness that was incredibly soothing! The applicator is a game-changer—it's easy to use and feels great on the skin! I love that I don't have to stick my finger into a jar just to get product out What I love most is how quickly it sinks in with no greasy residue left behind!! It's perfect for layering under makeup, and I've noticed a real difference in how well my concealer sits. Plus, the depuffing effect is noticeable; my under-eye area looks fresher and more awake. This eye gel has definitely become a staple in my summer skincare routine! In winter, I may layer this under a thicker/more hydrating eye cream as an added boost.

The Belif Aqua Bomb Eye Gel is a super moisturizing, easy to use product. The packaging is a semi matte, long tube that is easy to handle. I appreciate the size of the tube and the long bulbous, flat face tip because it's easy to maneuver under the eyes the gel easily squeezes out just the right amount with very little pressure. The gel itself is feels soothing on the skin. With days use, I have noticed the hydrating effects from the ingredients. I also notice my eyes are less puffy. I highly recommend the Belif Aqua Bomb Gel! It offers the hydration promised and leaves the eye area feeling soothed.

I used the product for 2 weeks under eyes twice day. Notice some difference by day 5. Still I don't think that it completely got rid of my dark circles, but I dont think 2 weeks is enough time to get rid or dark circles but I should've seen some difference by now.

The applicator is quite nice and cooling. It's refreshing and feels great when applying. Works nicely under makeup as well, so that's a win-win! I've thus far used it for over a couple weeks and will continue to use it.

I love the hands free applicator and how it provides a cooling effect. I've been using it for about a week now and while I'm not sure it beats my current eye cream it's definitely going to be considered for rotation. I already love some of the other belief products and can't wait to see what they come out with next.
I love how cooling the eye gel is. It feels so nice under the eye. I feel like my eye look less puffed the eye

I have been using this eye gel for a few weeks now and I am really love the result, I have dark circles, and this stuff helped me. It is really light and refreshing, and it doesn't feel greasy at all but only downside is that it can feel a bit sticky when you apply it, it is not a big deal for me, love the result and definitely recommend for a quick and easy way to brighten up eyes.

Belif kindly gave me this Aqua Bomb Eye Gel for free so that I could review it. I absolutely love the applicator, it's super cooling, refreshing, and applies the product smoothly and evenly. I wish all eye serums/gels/creams came in a similar applicator. As for the eye gel itself, I really did like the cooling sensation and I found it did diminish my eye bags. However, I didn't notice a difference in my dark circles which is a more significant issue for me than bags.
I love how easy it is to use and the cool tip on top for spreading the serum around the eye bags. It works very well on my skin
I've been searching so long for an amazing eye product after two days of use my eyes looked younger and brighter from the moisturizer all packed into a little easy to use pen I look amazing !

I was provided Aqua Bomb Eye Gel in exchange for my review. I have been using it for a few weeks now, and it has become a staple in my skincare routine! The lightweight formula absorbs quickly, leaving my under-eye area feeling cool and refreshed. The caffeine helps with puffiness, and I've noticed a visible reduction in my dark circles. Plus, the hyaluronic acid keeps the skin hydrated all day. It's perfect for tackling dryness and eye bags without feeling greasy. Highly recommend if you're looking for a quick, effective eye treatment!

The Aqua Bomb Eye Gel is a refreshing, lightweight product that absorbs quickly and leaves my under-eye area feeling hydrated and smooth. I love the applicator—it makes it super easy to apply without any mess. Perfect for reducing puffiness and brightening up tired eyes!

I have been a past user of the aqua bomb hydrating moisturizer and was super excited when I saw they came out with an eye gel! It's truly amazing. The applicator is easy to use and feels soooo good to put on. I just sit in front of the mirror and give my under eyes a little massage with the gel as I apply it. I have a new baby and two toddlers so sleep is a hit or miss these days. Using this each morning is a treat and helps me feel a bit more refreshed in the am despite my regular lack of sleep. Will definitely continue to use this as a go to product.

While I do think the packaging for this product is cool and well-designed, the eye gel itself really did nothing for me except irritate my skin. I did not notice any change in the appearance of my eye bags after using this product even after twice daily use for a week, and it leaves a sticky feeling on your under eyes which I'm not a fan of. I found it to be really irritating to my eyes if I put on makeup after or rubbed my eyes or was sweating at all over the course of the day. Good design, unimpressive product with typos on the packaging! I received this product to try for free for review from BzzAgent.

The Belif Aqua Bomb Eye Gel is super hydrating and helps moisturize and plump the eye area. I'm not a fan of the built-in applicator because it's not sanitary to apply the packaging directly to your skin, but it's easy enough to dispense onto my finger or another applicator instead.

Thanks Belif for the free Aqua bomb eye gel sent through Bzz agent!! I have been using this product so I could give an honest review, and it blew me away. I suffer from insomnia and couldn't find a product that took the bags under my eyes away as good as this one has!! It is so easy to use, I put it on right after I was my face am & pm. I have noticed less darkness around my eyes too!! I will 100% be buying this when my free sample runs out, and will be recommending to my friends!!

It is just amusing! Works 10 times faster than the under eye patches! And 10 times more convenient since there is no need to walk withe the head up and worry about them falling off! The effect gets visible in about 2 minutes! Ceramic tip gives a pleasant sensation of instant cooling-just love that part. Gel gets absorbed pretty quickly. Small tube packaging is very convenient to carry around.

avis.titre: This eye gel is ABSOLUTELY AMAZING!!!!
avis.texte: I have become very leary of eye creams! I've spent hundreds of dollars in the past on products that didn't measure up to their claims. When I received this free product to test I was skeptical, to say the least! I am SO HAPPY to say that BELIF AQUA BOMB EYE GEL is AMAZING!!! I truly was hooked from my first use and the results are unbelievable! Other products have proven time again to be heavy and they never layered well with makeup. This product is an ultra-lightweight, anti-aging treatment, that reduces puffiness right away. My concealer layers perfectly due to the smooth canvas that my under eye area transforms into. I LOVE that it has Vitamin C in it, which has been visibly targeting my hyperpigmentation under my eyes and making my eyes brighter in just days! I would recommend this product to ANYONE and I even have my husband using it now. I am so grateful for the opportunity to test this product for free. I can't compliment it enough! I would shout from the rooftops that I will buy again and again and again!!

avis.titre: Easy to use format for eye gel
avis.texte: I have been using this product for 2 weeks now. Comes in a stick format; you press down on the pump to release a small amount that appears directly on the applicator that you can apply under your eyes. Love that I don't have to get my fingers sticky in the process. The applicator is really cool (as in chilly) when I put it on, so it definitely wakes up my skin in the morning. Took a few tries to get used to the right amount. If you press all the way down, you will get way too much product for one application. I've been able to figure out the right pressure to get a tiny amount, apply under one eye, and repeat for the other eye. If not, product can get goopy and create a visible film which is not ideal for use in the morning under make up. But I've found using a very thin layer is fine. Only two weeks so not sure if this is going to change my eye bags long term, but it definitely looks a little perkier right after I apply. I was able to test this out thanks to a free sample from the company.

This eye bomb was so different I didn't know how to use it at first. But once I figured it out I've been using it to massage around my eyes every night. It's a nice cooling gel that comes out when you press down. It really helps with tired and baggy eyes. I do noticed some difference after using it for about 2 weeks. It's not sticky just a really nice refreshing feeling. I plan to continue to use this and hope for more results.

avis.titre: I love how convenient it is!
avis.texte: I want to thank BzzzAgent for allowing me the opportunity to try the Aqua Bomb Eye Gel. It feels light and hydrating and the packaging is very convenient. I look forward to seeing the effects it has on my eyes overtime.

I absolutely love this Aqua Bomb Eye Gel! The application process is so easy. I have tried many under eye gels, and the Aqua Bomb is by far the easiest to apply. It includes a smooth flat tip where the product dispenses out of, and you use this to smooth and spread the product around your eye area. The gel is soothing and I have definitely noticed lighter under eye circles.

avis.titre: I didn't like it at all
avis.texte: I normally don't care so much if my moisturizer is scented but this one being so close to my eyes and contains orange peel oil and rosemary leaf oil just didn't agree with my eyes. It was fine for the night I applied it, but after a few days of consecutive use, I noticed I got small pumps underneath my eyes. It's a shame that I didn't agree with my skin cuz I do love the brand.

avis.titre: Sleek Design and Nice Cooling Effect from Applicator
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using this product. In the morning is when my eye bags are the most dramatic so it is quite easy to see the difference; the cool applicator feels like a gua sha-type massage when applying the eye cream under my eyes… SO good! I enjoy the quickness in which the product began showing on me— within one full week!

avis.titre: Aqua Bomb eye gel effective for tired eyes!
avis.texte: Aqua bomb eye gel. Gel for the eye area, all its ingredients are the best to reduce eye bags, wrinkles and dark circles. Its ceramic applicator works cold and when applying the gel it reduces eye bags and moisturizes, with constant use the Expression lines are reduced as well as dark circles, it is one of the best eye products I have ever used

I enjoy the texture of this gel balm on my under eyes as well as the applicatior which makes it very satisfying to use. I feel like it adds a boost of hydration to my under eye area and especially like using it under a reusable eye mask!

I received this Eye Bomb Moisturizer from Skeepers for my honest review and I absolutely love it! I use it mainly for my under eye lines and bags. Whenever I use it at night, I feel like my skin is refreshed in the morning. I already have recommended this product to my sisters and definitely will be recommending this to my friends as well.

Haven't really used to many eye gels like this before, but it is out of this world in terms of results! Super easy to apply, lightweight, works and looks great. The applicator makes it even easier to apply! Will be adding this into my routine!

I love the Belif Aqua Bomb Eye Gel especially because of the cooling effect it has but also the ease of application with the ceramic tip and the pump that delivers the perfect amount each time. I'm definitely noticing a difference over time with fine lines and dark circles but can instantly notice that it depuffs the area. I would absolutely buy again and recommend to others!

This is an awesome eye gel! I love the applicator. It took me a minute to figure it out but you just keep clicking it and the gel will come out the top. A little bit goes a LONG way. The applicator is porcelain and you can rub it in with that. I also like to press it in with my finger. It's a very subtle difference but if you use it in the morning it definitely helps get rid of the bags under your eyes! I love Belif and this is another hit, absolutely adding to my routine.

Love the product. I love that I don't have to touch it. I just do a tiny pump to dispense the product. It's really nice and cooling without any stinging. It also seems like a pretty generous amount in the container
